scripts.dev:backend: uv run --package demo-backend python apps/backend/manage.py runserver 8000
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:ts && pnpm run typecheck:py
scripts.lint:py:check: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.verify: pnpm run typecheck:ts && pnpm run typecheck:py && pnpm run lint:py:check
scripts.verify:all: pnpm run verify && pnpm run test:py
